connector.name: KeyShot MCP
connector.registryDescription: Control local KeyShot scenes, cameras, environments, and renders through headless scripting.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package keyshot-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the truman-t3 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: KEYSHOT_HEADLESS_EXE
env.description: Absolute path to KeyShot headless, or a command available on PATH.

env.name: KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Root directory for rendered images and saved scenes.

env.name: KEYSHOT_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUTS
env.description: Set to true only when output paths outside KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR are required.

env.name: KEYSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Timeout in milliseconds for one KeyShot headless process.

env.name: KEYSHOT_MATERIAL_PRESETS
env.description: Optional path to a user-managed material preset JSON file.

env.name: KEYSHOT_CAMERA_PRESETS
env.description: Optional path to a user-managed camera preset JSON file.
